title.rendered: You Have the Mind of Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Four words that change everything: we have the mind of Christ. Not a goal to reach, a reality already true about every believer. You are not limited to your own understanding today.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Wednesday, May 6, 2026

📖 Today’s Scripture

“But we have the mind of Christ.”
1 Corinthians 2:16 (NIV) | ESV

📝 Today’s Message

Four words. No qualification, no caveat, no “if you pray enough” or “once you mature sufficiently.” We have the mind of Christ. Present tense. Indicative. This is a statement of what is already true about every believer, not a goal to work toward but a reality to walk in.

The mind of Christ means you have access to wisdom that transcends your education, your experience, your natural intelligence. When you face a decision that feels impossible, a situation that has no obvious answer, you are not limited to your own understanding. You have the mind of Christ.

Proverbs 3:5–6 says to trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding, in all your ways acknowledge Him and He will direct your paths. The mind of Christ operates as you lean into Him rather than relying exclusively on your natural reasoning.

James 1:5 is direct: if any of you lacks wisdom, ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault. The wisdom is available. The mind of Christ is yours. You already have it.

🙏 Prayer

Father, thank You that I have the mind of Christ. I am not limited to my own understanding or my own wisdom. Today, in every situation I face, I lean into the mind that You have given me, Your thoughts, Your perspective, Your solutions. I ask for Your wisdom and I receive it generously, as You promised. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🗣️ Declaration

I have the mind of Christ. I am not limited to natural understanding. God’s wisdom flows through me and I have access to His perspective on every situation I face today. I lean not on my own understanding but on the mind of Christ that is already mine. I receive wisdom generously and walk in divine clarity, not confusion.
